family: The single total uniform norm-one finite-field predicate of proof.md Section 1: f_n=0 for n<64; otherwise construct its deterministic quadratic-tower binary basis of dimension m=n-o(n), ignore the remaining tail bits, and accept exactly when z^((2^m-1)/(2^k-1))=1, with the exact all-length parameters defined there.
theorem: For this fixed polynomial-time computable family with an empty-witness NP verifier, liminf over all integer actual lengths n of C_B2(f_n)/n is at least 4947/1000 in the unrestricted deterministic exact full binary circuit model.
